new_hire_deadline_text: within the first 90 days of employment and annually thereafter
provider_approval_type: approved training videos by House Bill 390
applicable_to: commercial lodging establishments with 10 or more rooms
smaller establishments encouraged but not mandated
required_topics: identifying, responding to, and preventing human trafficking in the hospitality industry

required_content: human trafficking signage as per provided guidelines

recordkeeping_requirements: records showing compliance with the training requirement
available upon request from the Attorney General or law enforcement agencies
risks_or_constraints: non-compliance penalties include retaliation against employees who make good faith reports of suspected human trafficking
